findings.title: predicate=uses_database shows churn: 9 historical non-active facts
findings.detail: Repeated supersession/dispute on a single-cardinality predicate usually means a contamination source (e.g., example text in CLAUDE.md or docs) keeps re-introducing the same hallucination.
findings.suggestion: Find the contamination source: claude-memory recall <bad_value> --scope=project. Wrap the trigger text in <no-memory> tags. See docs/audit_runbook.md.

findings.title: 89% of decisions/conventions lack reason clauses (47/53)
findings.detail: Facts without 'because/so that/to avoid/...' lose their justification once context fades. Bare conclusions are dead weight when the team grows or you revisit a year later.
findings.suggestion: Inspect with: claude-memory explain <fact_id>. Reject low-value bare facts or rewrite with reason clauses via memory.store_extraction.

findings.title: 1 auto-memory file(s) not yet imported
findings.detail: ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/*.md files contain durable knowledge that isn't reachable via memory.recall until imported. AutoMemoryMirror only surfaces them transiently at SessionStart.
findings.suggestion: Preview: claude-memory import-auto-memory --dry-run. Import: claude-memory import-auto-memory.
